units.source_en: She abruptly rose, wanting to get away from him and find a little peace.
units.source_zh: 她蓦地站起身，想避开舅父，好好安静一下。

units.source_en: The sun had baked the ground outside scorching hot. Swallows skimmed past the verdant leaves, yet not the faintest cooling breeze stirred.
units.source_zh: 阳光把外面的土地烤得滚烫，燕子拂过翠绿的青叶，亦无一丝凉风。

paragraphs.source_zh: “哼！”茶茶突然有些哀怨地沉默。舅父不过处处遵循秀吉的旨意而已。她蓦地站起身，想避开舅父，好好安静一下。阳光把外面的土地烤得滚烫，燕子拂过翠绿的青叶，亦无一丝凉风。

paragraphs.source_en: Her lips trembling, Chacha said, “But I cannot be disposed of so casually. I am a kinswoman of Lord Nobunaga. I cannot be placed beneath Kita no Mandokoro, a woman of humble birth. You must negotiate these matters.”

paragraphs.source_en: “You mean the terms under which you are to be taken as his bride?”

units.source_en: “You mean the terms under which you are to be taken as his bride?”

paragraphs.source_zh: “你是说如何迎娶之事？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Of course! Have him build me a beautiful castle to my liking.”

paragraphs.source_en: “A castle?”

paragraphs.source_en: “Not some petty castle worth thirty or fifty thousand koku. It must rival Osaka Castle, be no less splendid than the Jurakudai, and be grand enough to proclaim the Kanpaku’s majesty.”

units.source_en: “It is not a report, but a negotiation.”

paragraphs.source_en: Chacha once more stared blankly outside. Her heart held three parts sorrow, three parts anger, three parts pain, and one part bewilderment. Tears gushed forth, wetting her cheeks and streaming endlessly down…
